page.notes: Catchword "riant," is at the right below the last line; the text ends on the hyphenated line "sen-" as printed. "sc.sunt" after "fovendi" is doubtful: the first letter looks like a long s/f, so it is marked [?]. "fine" in "sine membri" and "sine quo" is read as sine. Spelling such as "liturae", "fastu", "Monarchis", "idq;" and "neq;" is kept as printed. Italic runs cover the sentence beginning "Regimen Episcopale" and the passage from "Declaratur:" to "crimina.", and "Iure divino". The printed "Y 2" is the gathering signature.
